title: Persistence, persistence (dealing with people who refuse to let go)
coreMove: Stop rewarding pursuit with negotiation once refusal has already been given.
sourcePressure: Repeated pursuit after refusal is meaningful data; ambiguity and ongoing negotiation can feed a pattern that clear refusal and reduced access interrupt.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Romanticizing persistence as sincerity or treating all repeated contact as identical danger.
sourceAnchorNote: Frozen notes contain no traceable named anecdote, study, place, date, or artifact for this chapter; use fictional protagonists only and keep claims tied to the listed source pressure.
